sources.name: OGC API - Tiles - Part 1: Core
verified_facts: A tile is a spatially constrained fragment of a larger geospatial resource.
Tile requests bind tileMatrix, tileRow and tileCol to a declared TileMatrixSet.
Tileset metadata provides the tiling-scheme link and a templated link for individual tile retrieval.
semantic_limits: Successful tile retrieval proves addressability, not native source resolution or vertical accuracy.
A tile endpoint may serve maps, features or coverages; the returned media type and data role must be read back.

sources.name: Two Dimensional Tile Matrix Set and Tile Set Metadata 2.0
verified_facts: A TileMatrixSet indexes space using regular grids at a finite list of scales in a declared CRS.
TileMatrix metadata carries cellSize and scaleDenominator alongside matrix dimensions.
Scale denominator is based on a standardized rendering cell size and is not a terrain measurement uncertainty.
semantic_limits: Tile-matrix cell size is a delivery-grid property and must not be substituted for EA DTM acquisition resolution.
Changing tile-matrix level or resampling does not improve the source elevation accuracy.

sources.name: GeoPackage Extension for Tiled Gridded Coverage Data 1.1
verified_facts: The extension stores tiled regular gridded coverages such as digital elevation models.
Integer cells may require coverage-level and tile-level scale and offset before use; data_null is excluded from that conversion.
Ancillary metadata records precision, units, grid-cell encoding and the NULL sentinel; vertical CRS metadata defines reference datum, geoid and units.
semantic_limits: Stored integer values are not physical elevations until scale and offset are applied in the prescribed order.
NULL cells, rendering pyramid levels and interpolation must not be treated as new measurements or accuracy evidence.

sources.name: OGC API - Maps - Part 1: Core
verified_facts: A map is a visual portrayal produced by applying a style to geospatial data.
Map requests can change extent, dimensions, display resolution and CRS.
The same underlying resource may be exposed as a map portrayal and separately as coverage data.
semantic_limits: Rendered map pixels, colors, transparency and anti-aliasing are not numeric terrain samples.
Height min/max calculations must use the numeric coverage, not a styled map or map tile.
